title: Clarify autonomy path health launch gate
summary: Aligned the standalone autonomy health launch gate with the launch preflight path-health timeout and prevented path-health timeouts from being reported as low free space.
reason: A slow but reachable UNC output share could time out under the standalone 1-second gate, then the disk-state category surfaced the timeout as an insufficient-free-space blocker even when the share had more than the configured reserve.
behavior_before: PowerShell launch gating used the default 1-second configured-path probe and could log the first blocker as "Outsource output root has insufficient free space" when the UNC probe simply timed out.
behavior_after: The standalone launch gate uses the same 5-second path-health timeout as Launch preflight. Low-free-space blockers are emitted only when measured free space is below reserve; timed-out or unreachable roots stay blocked through configured path-health messaging.
manual_validation: Configured path-health rows measured Outsource output root free_space_gb=109.23 reserve_gb=50.0, LocalBase free_space_gb=621.14 reserve_gb=50.0, and Library TV output root free_space_gb=109.23 reserve_gb=50.0.
Reproduced current configured autonomy gate against live settings: exit=0, overall=review, blockers=0.
